title: Vredenburg, Utrecht. Busiest cycle path in the Netherlands
summary: A short BicycleDutch episode showing Vredenburg in Utrecht, the busiest cycle path in the Netherlands, with about 37,000 cyclists passing on a working day.
why: HN uses it as visual evidence that cycling can move huge numbers of commuters in little space.

quote.text: how much space would you need if every single cyclist was driving a large SUV?
